notes.title: 【Steel Ocean:Wolves of Deep Sea】Questionnaire survey welfare distribution announ
notes.content:
Hello Captains:
       We suggest that the questionnaire will be distributed on 3:00-4:00 Pacific Time on 3:00-4:00 Pacific Time on May 16, 2022 (18:00-19:00 Beijing Time on May 16, 2022). Please note that the relevant questionnaire will be sent to playtest.

Reward distribution rules
1. Low level: reward 2000 gold coins
2. Ordinary: 4000 gold coins
3. Advanced: 6000 gold coins
4. Major: 10000 gold coins
5. 500 gold coins will be awarded for repeated bugs
6. Individual submitted invalid bugs are not counted and rewarded.

tags.bug: 500 gold coins will be awarded for repeated bugs
